January: rookie signing month.
Negotiate with this year's most
sought-after prospects.

For a player you want to sign,
propose a contract length and
salary.

If the player accepts the terms, the
deal is done and they join next month.

If the terms don't suit, move on to
the next date and enter new terms.
This repeats for the whole month.

However, other clubs and overseas
sides will also be bidding for rookies
meanwhile, so make good offers early.

You can only negotiate with as many
players as you have free squad spots.

To meet more rookies than you have
free spots, transfer a player first.

You can also transfer players during
rookie talks, but it's an important
decision, so think carefully, okay?

Compete with other clubs, balancing
cost against squad size, to sign
your rookies.
